about: Held-out findings for the evidence check (fe-8vj). None of these existed when the question in lib/mastra/evidence-support.ts was rewritten.

'recorded-2026-09-26': every finding from one local run of the enrichRow workflow on 2026-09-26, with EVIDENCE_CHECK=0 so no finding was removed. Rows: hello@firecrawl.dev, support@supabase.com, hi@mintlify.com, support@langchain.dev, hello@convex.dev, support@hex.tech, hello@vanta.com, support@brex.com. Fields: companyName, companyDescription, industry, businessModel. The run returned 10 findings; the other groups failed their structured output and returned none. All 10 are included, so no selection rule was needed.
'derived-2026-09-26': variants built from the same fresh quotes (swapped companies, wrong and plausible-but-wrong categories, one alternative correct category), to give the set wrong values.
Every label was set by the labeling rule in labeled-findings.json before any item was scored. The quote is the finding's evidence joined with a newline, as checkEvidenceSupport sends it.

fields.companyDescription: A brief description of what the company does
fields.industry: The primary industry the company operates in
fields.businessModel: How the company makes money, e.g. subscription software, usage-based API, marketplace, advertising, hardware sales

API to convert entire websites into clean, LLM-ready markdown.
